pages.title: Psycrow!
pages.text: Psy-Crow is Jim's rival in Earthworm Jim (Shiny Entertainment, 1994), a giant crow in a spacesuit who also appears as a boss. In the Sega Retro summary of the story, he works for the evil Queen and blasts the ship that stole the super suit, which then falls on Jim.

pages.title: The fish-hook gun
pages.text: When Jim loses a race against Psy-Crow in Earthworm Jim, the crow attacks him with a fish-hook gun. Jim has to shoot him until he's dazed, and then whip him, says Sega Retro.
